name: 60083 · Wadsworth, IL
findings: ZIP 60083 (Wadsworth) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60083 (Wadsworth) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
